svg.title: FusionLynx system architecture
svg.desc: Vector system architecture for wheel odometry, FAST-LIO, fixed-lag fusion, RTAB-Map, health monitoring and robot TF ownership.
svg.text: Sensor streams, estimator ownership and diagnostic feedback
innovation / NIS, wheel consistency, IMU consistency
FAST-LIO provides local odometry and registered clouds; it does not publish the integrated odom -> base_link transform.
state_fusion_backend is the single dynamic owner of odom -> base_link and publishes /odom for downstream mapping.
RTAB-Map owns map -> odom; robot_state_publisher owns static base_link -> sensor transforms from URDF / Xacro.
IMU and magnetometer signals enter the health monitor in the current design; they do not directly form localization factors.
